description: Set the quantity (or substitution preference) of items already in the Harris Teeter cart. Quantity 0 removes the item. Nothing is ordered or charged.

substitutionPolicy.description: If the item is out of stock: SHOPPER_CHOICE (default — the shopper picks a similar item), CUSTOMER_CHOICE, CONTACT_CUSTOMER, or NONE (no substitute).

name: ht_update_cart_item
